minutes.headline: Planning Board continued the 39 Main Street school site plan hearing to May 8 and leaned toward a 15-member master plan committee.
minutes.summary: The board opened the site plan hearing for a school use with parking at 39 Main Street and continued it pending peer review and Conservation Commission action. It discussed the size and makeup of a master plan steering committee and agreed to circulate a 15-member draft. It also signed a decision, approved minutes, took committee reports, and discussed a model groundwater protection bylaw.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board voted to continue the 39 Main Street school-use site plan hearing to May 8, 2023, at 6:05 pm.
The planning director will draft a decision on 39 Main Street once peer review comments come back.
The board left the master plan steering committee draft at 15 members, labeled it a draft, and will send it to listed boards and department heads for feedback.
A state asset management grant is paying for the town's stormwater infrastructure to be mapped; no amount was given.
The board signed an endorsed decision without a motion and discussed a model groundwater protection bylaw as homework, with no action.

why_it_matters: The 39 Main Street school and parking proposal has not yet been approved; it waits on peer review and Conservation Commission action, so neighbors can still weigh in at the next hearing.
The size and makeup of the master plan steering committee decide who helps shape the town's long-range plan, and other boards will be asked for feedback on the 15-member draft.
